name: mp-host-hang
title: A world's host and a dedicated round's host stop answering past the hold window; the player returns to the menu with the reason inside the window and comes back to the world from its last autosave

scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 120
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 120
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 1 120
wait_substate Lobby 120
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 420
wait_ms 1400
exit

allowed_stills.reason: the player waits on its silent host until the hold window ends the round
the player waits on its silent host until the hold window ends the round

checklist.what: The player on the other machine plays the round over the relay before its host stops answering.
Every connection the player makes to its host, the return included, goes through the relay.
Back on the multiplayer menu, the status line names the hung host and the world's return, word for word.
checklist.assert: The host stopped responding. The round has ended; the world continues from its last save when the host is back.

host_hang.line: The host stopped responding. The round has ended; the world continues from its last save when the host is back.

checklist.what: Rejoin Match brings the player back into the host's world, which carries on from its last autosave.
